text:
Sam: Quick ask — I need to swap my Saturday oncall (UTC 06:00-14:00). Unexpected family thing, sorry for the late notice. I can hand off everything and leave a short checklist.
Alex: I can pick up Sat morning if someone takes my Sunday 22:00-06:00 (UTC). Does that work @Sam?
Sam: @Alex that works for me. If someone else can take Alex's Sun night then we can swap. I'll leave a runbook + prewarm steps.
Jin: I can take Alex's Sun 22-06 slot. Happy to swap. Pinged my manager; no conflicts.
Sam: Awesome, thanks @Jin. Handoff plan below — copying it into the thread so it's searchable.
Priya: Thanks for the clear notes. Do we need any special permissions for the private infra consoles during the Sat shift?
Sam: No new perms. Just standard oncall keys. Key items:
- Prewarm: run the model cache prewarm job for the 'rwd-instruct-v2' pool at 05:45 UTC. Command:
```bash
./infra/scripts/prewarm_cache --pool rwd-instruct-v2 --timeout 600
```
- Watch list: scheduled quantization job 08:00-08:30 UTC on Sat (non-blocking) — expect brief CPU spike on control-plane host infra-ctl-2.
- Canary: if generation latency > 500ms p50, shift to fallback model `rwd-instruct-v2-ptq` via the console route override.
- Escalation: PagerDuty -> primary infra-oncall -> if no response 10 mins -> eng-sre channel + call.
- Runbook link: https://internal.redwood/ops/oncall/runbooks/weekend-handoff

Alex: Got it, I'll prewarm at 05:45 and monitor the quant job. I'll also take screenshots of the console route change in case Jin needs to roll back.
Jin: I'll shadow the handoff at 13:30 UTC before taking over Sun. Can someone drop the short prewarm result logs here after it's run?
Sam: Sure — I'll paste the prewarm output once it's done. Expected output snippet:
```
prewarm: pool=rwd-instruct-v2 status=complete warmed_instances=12 avg_latency_ms=42
```
Alex: Noted. Also FYI — there's a minor config drift flagged in the console for model-concurrency on pool rwd-instruct-v2 (low severity). No action required unless latency > 700ms.
Priya: Thanks for flagging. @Alex please keep an eye and add to the postmortem tracker if it recurs.
oncall-bot: Swap recorded: Sam -> Alex (Sat 06:00-14:00). Alex -> Jin (Sun 22:00-06:00).
Sam: Thanks everyone, I owe you coffee. I'll post the full handoff doc in the morning and ping here when prewarm completes. :thumbsup:
Alex: Thanks — see you on Sat.
Jin: I'll confirm the Sun slot in PD and add it to my calendar.
Priya: All set from my side. Safe trip Sam.
